teams.name: Roosevelt
teams.note: The defending national champions, and a first title in school history, went 15-2 and won the playoff as the 4 seed, beating Ranroman 28-22, UNN 49-28 and Krobe State 30-24 before the 31-19 final over Pistolheart in Coachville. Tane Fifita is in year four, quarterback Haeun Yunye was a second-round pick and sophomore Gaspard Schneebruck takes over, with cornerback Yansa Ironotter and receiver Hala Wenli back and five-star lineman Paytah El-Tahir arriving. Voters gave them 35 first-place ballots, and the repeat bid opens at Keeper.

teams.note: The 2042 champions went 11-4 as the 2 seed, beat New Madrid 27-21 and then lost the quarterfinal 24-18 to Barhold at the Steam Bowl. Alessia Boischamp went first in the draft and cornerback Tariq Yawbayo in the second round, but lineman Tyrell Kingsmond and cornerbacks Tavesei Roresei and Varun Chalhoub return, with five-star tailback Verity Peatham joining them. Hollis Upshaw is in year seven, the opener is at home against Repidome, and the season closes at Central Stanton.

teams.name: North Hatesei
teams.note: They went 9-5 as the 14 seed, shut out German Shores 33-0 in the first round and then fell 24-19 to Phangrine State. Safety Noemie Cataldo was a first-round pick, but linemen Katarina Kleinhuber and Lomano Tallbuffalo, cornerback Kirovei Eisemyr and linebacker Taiga Wickbridge are all juniors and a 21-man class carries six blue-chips. Perla Notaro is in year three; the opener at Crayellan is in week 0 and the season ends at home against Hatesei.

teams.note: A year after opening as the poll's first choice, they went 8-4 and missed the playoff entirely. Seven players were drafted, among them linemen Octavia Danecott and safety Winona Rowden, but linebacker Howahkan Laufanua, sophomore quarterback Spiros Kyriapoulos and lineman Nico Boisbois return, with five-star Oddny Forsheim up front. Rami Campbell is in year 18, they open at Queensville and host Central Stanton in week 2.

teams.name: Pistolheart
teams.note: The 1 seed went 14-3, beat VSSC 23-14, Park Island 38-17 and Barhold 49-33, and then lost the final 31-19 to Roosevelt; the school is still waiting on a first title. Ryskamp winner Andres Clairlac went in the first round, so Yelena Blaubach arrives from Queensville at quarterback, with five-star lineman Viola Theokopoulos, cornerback Kysei Woolhurst and tailback Annunziata Campemonte around her. Tage Ludendorf is in year five and the season opens at home against Natzumakis State.

teams.note: The 13 seed went 12-4 and ran to the semifinals, beating NE Rogaela 41-10, Ciarralotta State 31-0 and Eona 24-18 before Pistolheart beat them 49-33 at the Star Bowl. Only one player was drafted, tailback Mose Swiftantler in the seventh round, so lineman Ghislaine Vignascio, receiver Francesca Passettoni, linebacker Barthelemy Virtaw and senior cornerback Ryoji Kagegawa are all back, and five-star lineman Arjun Oluchukwu joins them. Darnell Ellery is in year six and the opener is at home against Stanisburg.

teams.note: They went 8-4, finished 6-3 in the conference and missed the playoff. Cornerback Yuma Momose went in the first round, but sophomore quarterback Dulce Navamayor, receivers Franziska Sandstrom and Digby Loken and senior lineman Xavier Olunna return, and Pietro Agnidhara comes in from Underwood. Litowa Mesteniy is in year six, the schedule is one of the stiffest in the poll, and it starts at home against Ediville State and ends at Ranroman.

teams.note: The 8 seed went 11-3 and had a first-round bye, then lost 56-7 to UNN in a second-round game that got away early. Receiver Mireille Grijalva went in the first round and quarterback Tessa Vikstad in the second, so Beatrice Peatbourne is the quarterback now, with linemen Bhaskar Gangavasan and Wonho Sefbuike and five-star receiver Bastian Kirchberger. Layla Smith is in year 17; they open at Hatesei and close at Tengus.

teams.name: Ranroman
teams.note: The 16 seed went 9-5, beat Leafette 17-6 and then lost 28-22 to eventual champion Roosevelt. Lineman Renshu Yi-Seok went in the third round, but tight end Trilok Bhadrashankar and linemen Kyungja Ra-Jun, Nicolas Grandbois and Meivo Tirsei return, with a 21-man class carrying six blue-chips. Ghislaine Penahermosa is in year five, the schedule is among the hardest in the poll, and it ends at home against Ranroman State.

teams.note: They went 12-2 as the 3 seed and lost the second-round game 41-10 to Park Island after a first-round bye. Three players went in the first round, Verity Hyun-Nam, Oliver Goldstead and Wapasha Lamedeer, and defensive coordinator Tyrell Marshden left to become head coach at Ciarralotta State, but lineman Sixten Schneehardt, linebacker Tsumugi Takasaka and tight end Akosua Gyesowah are back and Faisal Owukah arrives from Cordelle at quarterback. Moritz Lamehawk is in year five, still chasing the school's first title, and the opener is at home against Ekralund State.

teams.note: The 15 seed went 8-5 and lost the first-round game 34-25 to Park Island. Tight end Ziad Anywale and lineman Efrain Charbec went in the second round, but receivers Rupert Goldridge and Kazue Shiranari are back, tailback Ramatoulaye Meitrovaw has transferred in from Verigon State, and cornerback Waimarie Crookedcreek and lineman Kyungja Un-Ho are sophomores. Henrik Moreau is in year five, the slate is the second-hardest in the poll, and the season opens at home against RU Herriman.

teams.name: Park Island
teams.note: The 18 seed had no bye and no cushion and still went 12-4, beating Kaji Daun 34-25 and UFNH 41-10 before Pistolheart stopped them 38-17 in the quarterfinal at the 501 Bowl. Tailback Hosei Mesysei went in the first round and lineman Ilaria Apogiannis in the second, but linemen Dieter Eisenhuber and Edouard Man-Jin, receiver Jagdish El-Sahli and safety Umberto Neraiani are all juniors, and five-star lineman Baard Althagen arrives. Florian Saintfour is in year two and the opener is a week-0 home game against Eternal Fox.

teams.note: The 12 seed went 9-4 and lost the first-round game 23-20 to New Madrid in two overtimes. Seven players were drafted, including receivers Michio Sugita and Otto Wolfbaum in the first round, so Osama Haugland arrives from Clark at quarterback, lineman George Laville, cornerback Clara Kaltmeier and lineman Bassam Somakanth are back, and kicker Essence Adenna transfers in from Diveo. Ji-woo Hall is in year 15, still waiting on a first title, and the opener is at home against Crayellan State.

teams.note: The 6 seed went 11-3 and lost the second-round game 31-0 to Barhold after a first-round bye. Head coach Latu left for Leafette and took receiver Guadalupe Petitpre and cornerback Mahdi El-Khalidi with him, and UFNH defensive coordinator Tyrell Marshden steps in as the new head coach. Linebacker Arjun Baili, lineman Nikhil Ramaprasad and five-star receiver Zhihao Go-Su lead a roster that opens at home against Westburg and gets Ranroman in week 2.

teams.note: They went 8-4 and did not reach the playoff, four years after their 2040 title. Safety Yannaw Yentrovaw went in the first round among seven draftees, but quarterback Heriberto Holmhus, cornerbacks Sungmin Shiratsu and Chiyo Xiangpei and senior receiver Kiona Eaglebear return. Bhaskar El-Mahdi is in year five; they open at home against UFFL, visit Central Stanton in week 3 and finish at Keeper.

teams.name: Marblehead
teams.note: The 11 seed went 11-4, beat Wolford 28-7 and lost 21-3 to Krobe State in the second round. Quarterback Varun Balaraj went in the second round, but sophomore Chidinma Gyebayo takes over, with lineman Danica Vlahos, safety Maoxin Taoduo and receiver Bora Ha-Bae back and five-star linebacker Devonte Durmore arriving. Onawa Khan is in year 16 and the opener is at home against Towgrade.

teams.note: The 2043 national champions went 7-5, finished 4-5 in the conference and missed the playoff. Linebackers Doyoon Beom-Sik and Joachim Granmo were both drafted, and Beatrice Momose arrives as head coach from Costique, where she was the offensive coordinator. Senior lineman Frode Althardt, tight end Souad Lahham and sophomores Antonella Cisneros and Douaa Agniraj lead what is left, and the first game is at Costique.

Quarterback Rongrong Baifei, a Ryskamp finalist, is back as a junior, along with linemen Salma El-Mahdi and Waimarie Bergstad and safety Esi Onyesah, and five-star tight end Alofa Kamacharya arrives. Rosario Sotofria is in year eight and the opener is at Antiragal.

teams.note: The 5 seed went 11-4, beat North Hatesei 24-19 and was then shut out 34-0 by Krobe State in the quarterfinal at the Redwood Bowl. Quarterback Stamatia Georzoglou went in the second round and tight end Ataahua Tallwater in the third, but lineman Greta Bernberger, tailback Danica Wysocki and tight end Runa Storgren return, and the 27-man signing class was the best of the offseason by points. Sybil Marshdale is in year five and the opener is at home against Cordelle.

teams.note: They went 8-4 after being ranked as high as second in the media poll in October. Six players were drafted, led by tight end Cristobal Penanueva in the first round and lineman Kwame Ismirrei in the second, and Valdemar Lindqvist is back at tight end after transferring from UN Minko, with linebacker Uchenna Zamorano and linemen Estevaw Teyresei and Anei Hanlaniy as sophomores. Sora Yamamoto is in year seven; they open at Lornaman and finish at home against Rogaela State.

in.name: Klaus Kamenovsky

teams.note: They went 5-7 and 3-6 in the conference, the worst record in the poll's top 25. William Brookborough arrives as head coach after being poached from Eona Navy, and cornerback Klaus Kamenovsky followed him, with lineman Shanice Claybury and Byungchan Baldobruno joining too. Receiver Chengfei Ningbo and cornerback Celestine Terrini were both second-round picks, linebacker Kanei Lorresei and linemen Dandan Fangsai and Faustino Kaltecker remain, and the schedule is the hardest in the poll, starting at home against Stokie.

teams.name: Skylar Rose
teams.note: They went 9-3 and 7-2 in the conference and were left out of the playoff field. Tailback Itzel Torrabella and lineman Xiuying Ningshai were first-round picks, but safeties Laurent Serraettoni and Amelia Vieuxville, linebacker Guowei Nagabe and sophomores Osama Blackden and Sakura Aosaka return. Amir Chen is in year nine and the opener is at home against Central Antiragal.

teams.note: The 9 seed went 10-5, beat Underwood 51-15 and Tengus State 56-7, and then lost the quarterfinal 49-28 to Roosevelt at the Copper Bowl. Receivers Evangelos Lambrmatos and Vasudev Al-Mahdi are juniors, sophomore quarterback Raviy Messei returns with five-star Tevin Langwood alongside him, and senior linebacker Zbigniew Chidambaram anchors the defense. Esperanza Caraobruno is in year seven, the opener is at home against UN Steelbridge, and the season ends against Hatesei and Pistolheart.

teams.name: Fiota Bay
teams.note: They went 9-4 and missed the playoff after reaching second in the media poll before a late slide. Five players were drafted, including receiver Siegfried Teylemyr and lineman Xavier Ezenti in the third round, but tight end Adel Failagi, quarterback Sunita Balaprasad and lineman Rowena Salaabella return, and the 23-man class carries five blue-chips. Catalina Eastwood is in year eight and the opener is at home against North Central.

teams.note: The only lower-tier team in the poll's top 25 went 12-2 as the 19 seed and lost the first-round game 33-0 to North Hatesei. Only one player was drafted, so receiver Rongrong Yaotong, tailback Wanda Chikelu, punter Omyr Madhukumar and lineman Angelique Highshaw all return, and four-star lineman Dongmei Changxia arrives. Tsuvai Nosemyr leads the staff, the schedule is one of the lightest in the poll, and the opener is at home against Starfield.
